replace_if_match :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map (lambda (regex_if (regex_match $1 $0) $2 $0)) (regex_split '.' $2))))))
description: A function that replaces a substring in a full string if a specified condition is met. It takes a full string, a replacement substring, and a target substring. If the target substring is found in the full string, it is replaced with the replacement substring.

vowel_or_consonant :: tsubstr
(regex_or 'a' (regex_or 'e' (regex_or 'i' (regex_or 'o' 'u'))))
description: A function that checks if a character is a vowel ('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u') or a consonant.

replace_concat_with_cdr_split :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_cons (regex_concat $0 $1) (regex_cdr (regex_split '.' $2)))))))
description: A function that replaces the concatenation of two substrings in a full string with the rest of the string after splitting by a delimiter.

replace_with_custom_logic :: tfullstr -> (tsubstr -> tsubstr) -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map $0 (regex_split '.' $1)))))
description: A function that applies custom replacement logic to substrings in a full string. It takes a full string and a function that defines the replacement logic. The function splits the full string by '.' and applies the custom logic to each substring.

replace_end_of_string :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append $0 (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_split '.' $1))))))
description: A function that replaces the end of a full string with a specified substring. It takes a full string and a replacement substring, and replaces the end of the string after splitting by '.' with the specified substring.

replace_concat_end_with_reversed_split :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append (regex_concat $0 $1) (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_split empty_string $2))))))))
description: A function that replaces the concatenation of two substrings at the end of a full string with the reversed split of the string by an empty string.

add_n_after_vowel :: tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (replace_with_custom_logic $0 (lambda (regex_if (regex_match vowel_or_consonant $0) (regex_concat $0 $2) $0)))))
description: A function that adds a specified character after a vowel in a full string based on custom logic. If the substring is a vowel, the specified character is added after it in the string.

append_substring_to_end :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append $0 (regex_split empty_string $1)))))
description: A function that appends a specified substring to the end of a full string.

replace_vowel_with_custom_concat :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (replace_if_match $0 (regex_concat $1 $2) vowel_or_consonant))))
description: A function that replaces a vowel in a full string with a custom concatenation of characters. It takes a target vowel, a replacement concatenation, and a full string. If a vowel is found in the full string, it is replaced with the specified concatenation.
